incidents.summary: Capricorn disputed a Senegalese tax notice claiming unpaid registration duty and capital gains tax on its sale of Senegal interests, with claims totaling USD 42.7 million including penalties and interest.

sources.title: Capricorn receives tax notice on Senegal exit
sources.quote: The notice claims Capricorn should have paid registration duty on the transfer. Furthermore, Woodside should have withheld capital gains tax.

sources.title: Capricorn receives tax notice on Senegal exit
sources.quote: The former claim is worth $28.2 million, while the latter is $14.5mn. Both include penalties and interest.

sources.title: Capricorn receives tax notice on Senegal exit
sources.quote: Under the agreement with Woodside, Capricorn is responsible for registration and capital gains payments.
